verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents porting numbers into Google Voice and admin activity reporting, but nothing about exporting a user's calls, messages or voicemails in open formats. Community reports of porting numbers away cover number portability, not data export. One user's note that they had no backup of their Voice messages suggests export is not obvious, but does not show any export capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
